article.title: Hold the Line: What You Can Do to Defend Democracy this Election Season
article.author: Hardy Merriman
article.content: The 2026 midterm elections are less than one week away – and right now, our freedom to vote, to have our votes counted, and to have the results respected are all under threat. With increasing frequency, the Trump Administration makes its intentions clear.
